title: acs step state (runs/<run-id>/steps/<skill>/state.json)
description: The STEP machine (§4.4): one skill's progress inside a run. Replaces <skill>-state.json. This schema validates the ENVELOPE only -- the `states` keys and the `outcome` vocabulary are declared per skill in skills/<name>/state.schema.json, so a new skill is a directory rather than an edit here. `skill` carries no enum for the same reason: it validates against the skill directories. `runs[]` became `invocations[]` because, once the partition is runs/<run-id>/, a `runs` array inside a step meant the wrong thing.

states.description: Validated against the skill's own fragment, not here.

invocations.description: One record per session's attempt at this step. A resumed step appends rather than overwriting, so an interrupted attempt's cost and session trail survive it.
